remarks:
New price brings unmatched value to this premier Clarence location! Welcome to 8817 Stonebriar Drive, a spectacular 4-bedroom Colonial beautifully situated on one of the town’s most desirable streets. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by an expansive, sun-drenched floor plan accented by exquisite architectural details and rich rosewood floors that flow seamlessly across both the first and second levels.
At the heart of the home is a chef’s kitchen complete with brand-new appliances and updated designer lighting, making it a stylish haven for daily living and upscale entertaining alike. The home's true showpiece is the breathtaking two-story family room, featuring soaring ceilings, classic palladium windows, a striking gas fireplace, and a secondary staircase that climbs to a versatile second-floor loft. For more formal gatherings, the elegant living and dining rooms provide the perfect backdrop, balanced by a sophisticated private den dressed in gorgeous custom built-in shelving and a deep coffered ceiling.
Upstairs, the home continues to impress with generously sized bedrooms, highlighted by a luxurious primary suite boasting a cozy two-sided fireplace, a glamorous spa-like bath, and an expansive walk-in closet. Practical comfort meets quality engineering with thermal Pella windows throughout and two independent staircases for smooth household flow. Downstairs, a partially finished daylight basement with an egress window offers the ultimate flexible space for a recreation room, home gym, or media center. Transition outside through the inviting morning room to a beautifully stamped concrete patio—your own private retreat for indoor-outdoor living. Impeccably detailed and newly priced at $925,000, this stunning home is an absolute must-see opportunity. Schedule your tour today!
